name: Orrery
author: Erin Carter
description: Six faint etched orbit rings centred on the dark field, each carrying one small glowing body trailing a short arc of phosphor smear. Bodies revolve at clock-steady commensurate rates — 8 seconds on the innermost lap, over a minute on the outermost — and when a pair drifts into alignment a hair-thin radial resonance line fades up between them, flares gently at conjunction, and fades away.

params.label: Orbit speed
params.effect: Scales every body's angular rate together, from contemplative planetarium drift to busy clockwork whirl, without changing the period ratios.

params.label: Ring gap
params.effect: Spacing between adjacent orbit rings (scaled to the viewport so the system fits); tight spacing nests the system compactly at centre, wide spacing spreads orbits toward the frame edges.

params.label: Flare
params.effect: Intensity of the resonance line drawn between aligning bodies — invisible at 0, a clearly visible luminous chord briefly bridging the rings at max.
